subject: Recent Chrome update is causing immediate drop of local host:8100 connection.

messages.author: 4245924341146ca2
messages.subject: Recent Chrome update is causing immediate drop of local host:8100 connection.
parts:
I have had a large Shiny based GUI working for several months. It connected to Chrome, Firefox, and Safari using localhost:8100 as the URL.

Within the last day or two, Chrome did an update and now when I try to use it to connect to the Shiny app, it momentarily connects, showing the expected widgets, then it goes gray. This behavior repeats when a refresh is done.

For what it's worth, I have this behavior on IE10, but just chalked it up to a Microsoft idiosyncrasy. Now I think I may have done IE10 a disservice.
